mapper.select: SELECT form_id::TEXT AS row_id, title, type_cd FROM form WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY title

SELECT f.form_id::TEXT AS row_id, f.title, f.description, f.type_cd, tc.name AS type_name, f.start_dt, f.end_dt, f.login_yn, f.multi_yn, f.done_message, f.use_yn FROM form f LEFT JOIN code tc ON tc.code_id = f.type_cd AND tc.p_code_id = 'FORM00' WHERE f.form_id = #{rowId}::integer AND f.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO form (title, description, type_cd, start_dt, end_dt, login_yn, multi_yn, done_message, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{typeCd}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{loginYn}, ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{multiYn}, ''), 'N'), #{doneMessage}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE form SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, type_cd = #{typeCd}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, login_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{loginYn}, ''), 'Y'), multi_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{multiYn}, ''), 'N'), done_message = #{doneMessage}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE form_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE form SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE form_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE form_field SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE form_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE form_answer SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE form_id = #{rowId}::integer
